name: @chips/plugin-markdown
description: Markdown 服务插件：Markdown → 安全 HTML / 结构化块（Cordis 服务，不注册 Bridge 能力）

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => { for (const p of ['dist', 'coverage']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.package: pnpm exec chips plugin pack --out dist/
